result: In the enabled counter update, replace the explicit `count == {WIDTH{1'b1}}` branch and `count_next` selection with an unconditional WIDTH-bit `count + 1'b1` assignment, and derive the asserted overflow value from the pre-edge count being all ones. Preserve reset-over-load-over-enable priority, overflow hold when disabled, overflow clearing on load, synchronous reset, and the existing one-cycle-old registered threshold flags. Keep parameter and high-bit semantics unchanged, add no latency annotation, and assess promotion only after the fixed simulation and routed metric gates pass with strictly fewer LUTs.
